front.title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
front.tldr: OpenAI has rolled out GPT-6 to all ChatGPT users worldwide, paired with a new Intelligent UI that answers with interactive visuals rather than plain text, its biggest interface change since launch.

front.title: Apple and The King's Trust launch initiative to empower young creatives
front.tldr: Apple and The King's Trust are expanding their partnership with a new programme of workshops to help young people in the UK build creative and digital skills for work.

front.title: Drake Maye Named AFC Offensive Player of the Week
front.tldr: Quarterback Drake Maye was named AFC Offensive Player of the Week after completing 22 of 37 passes for 269 yards and three touchdowns in New England's 29-26 win over Buffalo.

stories.title: Claude Haiku 5.5
stories.tldr: Anthropic has released Claude Haiku 5.5, a faster, cheaper model replacing Haiku 4.5, which launched almost a year ago and had fallen behind on cost and speed for lightweight tasks.

stories.title: Nous Research confirms it hit $1.5B valuation, launches AI agents for business users
stories.tldr: Nous Research has confirmed a $1.5 billion valuation after raising a $90 million Series B, and is launching Hermes Agent, a set of AI agents built for business users.

stories.title: Meta's Muse launches on iPad just a month after its mobile debut
stories.tldr: Meta's AI agent Muse is now available on iPad, barely a month after its phone debut, as the company rapidly widens the assistant's reach across devices.

stories.title: Introducing Playground: Create and play custom games
stories.tldr: Google Labs has launched Playground, an experimental platform that lets anyone create, play and share browser-based games using simple text prompts, no coding required.

stories.title: Google's new SynthID website can identify AI-generated media
stories.tldr: Google has launched a public SynthID website that lets anyone check whether an image, video or audio clip was generated using AI, extending a tool first given to journalists last year.

stories.title: Robot data startup Mecka AI nabs $60M from Sequoia
stories.tldr: Mecka AI has raised $60 million from Sequoia to pay people for recordings of everyday tasks, building motion data used to train humanoid and other robots.

stories.title: While VCs crowd into San Francisco, Endeavor Catalyst raises $320M for founders 'elsewhere'
stories.tldr: Endeavor Catalyst has raised $320 million to keep backing founders outside Silicon Valley, with half its profits returned to the nonprofit that sources them.

stories.title: SpaceX alumni nab $100M to rethink shipping with autonomous freight trains
stories.tldr: Parallel Systems, founded by SpaceX alumni, has raised $100 million to scale its autonomous electric rail vehicle, which can move thousands of pounds of freight up to 500 miles.

stories.title: Everything announced at Microsoft's Windows and Surface event
stories.tldr: Microsoft used its Windows and Surface event to unveil the $2,599 Surface Laptop Ultra built on Nvidia chips, alongside new agentic AI features coming to Windows.

stories.title: Manchester's Bee Card Now Fully Supported in Apple Wallet
stories.tldr: Transport for Greater Manchester's Bee Card now works fully in Apple Wallet on iPhone and Apple Watch, having previously been limited to younger riders on free or reduced fares.

stories.title: Boston's MBTA Testing New Charlie Card With Apple Wallet Support
stories.tldr: Boston's MBTA is testing a new version of the Charlie Card with Apple Wallet support, letting riders add it to iPhone and Apple Watch for tapping through the T.

stories.title: Spotify starts rolling out audiobooks to more than 180 markets
stories.tldr: Spotify is rolling out its audiobooks section globally, giving listeners in more than 180 markets access to over 350,000 titles spanning more than 120 languages.

stories.title: WhatsApp expands the Liquid Glass design to its video player
stories.tldr: WhatsApp continues adopting Apple's Liquid Glass look, bringing the redesigned visual style to its in-app video player as the rollout spreads across the rest of the interface.

stories.title: London Film Festival Hails the 'Great Andrew Scott' as 'Elsinore' Opens 70th Edition
stories.tldr: The 70th BFI London Film Festival opened with the European premiere of 'Elsinore', starring Andrew Scott, who received an emotional ovation from the Royal Festival Hall audience.

stories.title: 'The Debut': Jesse Eisenberg Praises Oscar Frontrunner Julianne Moore's 'Perfect Performance' at NYFF
stories.tldr: Jesse Eisenberg praised co-star Julianne Moore's performance in 'The Debut' as 'perfect' at its New York Film Festival premiere, where she is considered an early Oscar frontrunner.

stories.title: International Oscar Submissions: China, Syria, Denmark, Italy, France and More Join the List
stories.tldr: Countries including China, Syria, Denmark, Italy and France have submitted films for the international feature Oscar, with the shortlist due on 15 December from this year's entries.

stories.title: How Mike Flanagan's Carrie TV Series Sets Up A New Stephen King Universe
stories.tldr: Mike Flanagan's new Carrie series for Prime Video makes significant changes from Stephen King's novel, laying groundwork that could open the door to a wider Stephen King television universe.

stories.title: How the Celtics' Roster Is Primed to Beat an NBA's Point of Emphasis
stories.tldr: The NBA's Competition Committee has flagged four officiating focus areas for 2026-27, including push-offs and hand-checking, and CelticsBlog argues Boston's roster is already built to exploit the new emphasis.

stories.title: Patriots News: Pats' Aggression Was Their Edge
stories.tldr: New England went for it on fourth down twice and converted both, plus a two-point try, in Sunday's win over Buffalo, aggression Pats Pulpit credits for the result.

stories.title: The Number Crunch: Patriots' Win in Buffalo a Tale of 2 Quarterbacks
stories.tldr: Pats Pulpit's stats breakdown of Sunday's win over Buffalo frames it as one of New England's biggest regular-season results in years, contrasting Drake Maye's outing with Josh Allen's.

stories.title: Apple TV Announces Major F1 Broadcast Upgrade for United States Grand Prix
stories.tldr: Dolby and Apple are bringing upgraded Dolby Atmos sound to Apple TV's Formula 1 coverage from the United States Grand Prix weekend starting 23 October.

stories.title: Max Verstappen on Life After Christian Horner: 'It Is Less Stressful'
stories.tldr: Max Verstappen says the Red Bull paddock feels less stressful since Christian Horner's exit, telling the Press Association he no longer misses the friction Horner's leadership created.

stories.title: Fernando Alonso Set for Dakar Rally Comeback With Aston Martin
stories.tldr: Fernando Alonso has reportedly agreed terms to contest the 2027 Dakar Rally with Aston Martin, adding a cross-discipline challenge alongside his Formula 1 commitments.

stories.title: Kiké Hernández Ties David Ortiz on All-Time Postseason Home Run Leaderboard
stories.tldr: Kiké Hernández hit his 17th career postseason home run, drawing level with David Ortiz on the Red Sox's all-time postseason leaderboard.

stories.title: Alex Cora Reportedly Turned Down Phillies Offer Again, Won't Manage in 2027
stories.tldr: Alex Cora has reportedly turned down the Phillies' managerial offer for a second time and does not plan to manage any team in 2027.

finally.title: Blue Planet III
finally.tldr: BBC Earth is returning to the ocean 25 years after the original, with David Attenborough narrating 'Blue Planet III', and a first-look video is now out.
